snippet.title: Playtiles x Mega Cat Studios Collection is here!
snippet.description:
We teamed up with @megacatstudios to bring you a special bundle featuring an exclusive Playtiles controller + 7 iconic games from their catalogue.

Scan the QR code, stick the controller onto your smartphone screen (iOS & Android), and turn your phone into a gaming handheld with 7 titles (8bit & 16bit included) added to your PlaytilesOS library:

- Kudzu (8-bit) - Adventure
- Little Medusa (16-bit) - Puzzle, Platformer
- Old Towers (16-bit) - Action
- Romeow and Julicat (16-bit) - Puzzle
- Coffee Crisis (16-bit) - Fighting, Action
- Misplaced (16-bit) - Puzzle
- Devwill Too MD (16-bit) - Platformer

Play these games anytime, anywhere: now on your phone with real physical buttons!

Pre-order now for €25, worldwide shipping October 2026!

Discover more: https://limited.playtil.es/campaign.html?id=megacatstudioscollection
